tablero.instalar_ios: Install: tap Share and "Add to Home Screen"
tablero.pago_pendiente_detalle: To add one: go to business.facebook.com/settings → Accounts → Messaging accounts → choose the one with your number → Payment settings → add a card. As soon as you add it, reminders turn back on by themselves. If you'd rather not use this channel, you can turn off the WhatsApp reminder under Appointments → Reminders and keep using only the email one (free).
tablero.pago_pendiente_ayuda: Want us to help? Message us on WhatsApp
tablero.resena_label: Link to leave a Google review
tablero.resena_hint: We use it to offer to ask the customer for a review when you mark a sale as closed.
tablero.emp_hint: Each employee only sees the leads of the department you assign. You (Management) still see everything.
tablero.emp_ninguno: You haven't added any employees yet.
tablero.emp_confirmar_borrar: Delete this employee? They will no longer be able to log in to the CRM.
tablero.mm_hint: Send a WhatsApp message to every contact with a specific tag (e.g. "VIP"). If more than 24 hours have passed since that person wrote to you, Meta still delivers it but as a paid template message, charged to the card on your Meta Business account - if it is still within 24 hours, it is free.
tablero.mm_placeholder: Write the message that will be sent to each contact...
tablero.mm_contactos_uno: {whatsapp} of {n} contact with that tag has WhatsApp.
tablero.mm_contactos_otros: {whatsapp} of {n} contacts with that tag have WhatsApp.
tablero.mm_conteo: {contactos} Messages sent outside the 24-hour window are billed by Meta at your country's template rate.
tablero.mm_confirmar: Send this message to every contact tagged "{etiqueta}"? It may have a real cost on your WhatsApp account.
tablero.mm_listo: Done: {enviados} ({plantilla} as a paid template), {fallidos} failed, {sinWhatsapp} without WhatsApp.
tablero.imp_resumen_uno: We found {n} row in the file. Tell us which column is each piece of data:
tablero.imp_resumen_otros: We found {n} rows in the file. Tell us which column is each piece of data:
tablero.imp_sin_filas: The file has no data rows (only a header, or it is empty).
tablero.imp_elegi_contacto: Choose at least the contact column.
tablero.frio_title: No news in more than {dias} days
tablero.banner_gracia_uno: Your plan has expired and we stopped sending automatic replies. You have {n} day left to reactivate it before the service is fully cut off.
tablero.banner_gracia_otros: Your plan has expired and we stopped sending automatic replies. You have {n} days left to reactivate it before the service is fully cut off.
tablero.banner_cortado: Your service is suspended for non-payment - new inquiries are not being saved. See everything you are missing and reactivate whenever you want, your data is intact.
tablero.banner_pago_wa: Your appointment reminders are not being sent by WhatsApp: Meta requires a payment method on your Meta Business account to process these messages, and you haven't set one up yet. Appointments are still booked normally, the message just isn't sent.
tablero.error_link_pago: Could not generate the payment link.
tablero.enviado_plantilla: Sent as a paid template message - more than 24 hours had passed.
tablero.resena_mensaje: Hi {nombre}! Thank you for trusting us. If you liked it, would you leave us a review? {link}
tablero.pedir_resena: Ask for a review on WhatsApp
tablero.nota_ph: Write a note for the team...
tablero.aviso_24hs: More than 24 hours have passed since the customer's last message - this message is still sent, but as a paid template message, charged to the card on your Meta Business account.
tablero.uso_wa_detalle: Meta charges for WhatsApp messages sent outside the 24 hours after a customer's last message. Appointment confirmations and reminders fall under that rate, which depends on your country and is charged to the card you added to your Meta Business account.
tablero.uso_wa_tarjeta: If you haven't added a card there yet, the message isn't sent and the appointment is still booked - to add one: business.facebook.com/settings → Accounts → Messaging accounts → the one with your number → Payment settings.
tablero.uso_audio_detalle: Once you go over that number, audio messages are still received and saved, but not transcribed or answered with voice until next month.
